That's a great question! To get the best performance and longevity out of your mattress, there are a few key things to keep in mind. 💡

Use a Proper Foundation: All of our mattresses require a support system with a firm, flat surface. This could be a modern foundation, a platform bed, or a slatted base. For slatted bases, the slats should be thick and no more than 4 to 5.5 inches apart to prevent sagging and ensure proper support.
Rotate, Don't Flip: Most modern mattresses, including the ones we carry, are designed to be one-sided. They should be rotated 180 degrees every 6 to 8 months to ensure even wear, but they should not be flipped over.
Allow for an Adjustment Period: As I mentioned, we recommend sleeping on your new mattress for at least 30 nights. This gives the mattress time to break in and your body time to adjust to the new level of support.

Following these steps will help you get the best possible sleep experience! Is there anything else I can help you with?
